purpose: Review criteria for code targets: lists the delegated SSOT documents, the order to check them, and the rules for choosing fix, create_issue or skip. It holds no severity judgments itself.
summary: SoT is the review priorities spec; severity comes from delegated principles catalogs
SSOT reference table with P1 to P3 priorities
P1 sources: project-specific coding rules via query-db-rules, related design docs, deterministic generation spec
P2 checks contradictions between design docs and target code
P3 checks unnecessary complexity via anti-patterns document
Check order for P1 rule conformance, P2 contradictions, P3 complexity
Decision rules for fix, create_issue and skip recommendations
Three conditions for create_issue: no existing rule, recurrence or objectivity, codifiable granularity
Fallback to built-in rules when project rules are absent
tasks: Reviewing source code against project rules and design documents
Building a review packet for a code review
Deciding the recommendation for a code review finding
Judging whether to raise create_issue for an unruled finding
Checking contradictions between design documents and implementation
Editing or extending the code review criteria
title: code レビュー基準
